row.notes: Secondary (transform listener) vtable of the render model component, next to vt_Render_ModelComponent (0x145a908a0) and its cell 18 onward (0x145a908a0 + 0x90). The ctors 0x1444d1180 (lea at 0x1444d1196) and 0x1444e0210 (lea at 0x1444e024d) store it at component +0x18; 0x1444d1310, 0x1444d1450 and 0x1444d1580 store it through adjusted this pointers ([rcx], [rcx-8], [rcx-0x10]). Slot 0 0x1444d1310, slot 1 = Render_ModelComponent_OnTransform (0x144470870, cell 0x145a90938, this = component+0x18, rdx = 4x4 world matrix). Slot count not proven. Used by vmknolle dukati-lean (slot 1: lean the bike model matrix).
